title: 第28章 火毒宗
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
从落雁谷到火毒宗，骑马五天。

    苏荇留在谷里等第三枚紫鳞果成熟，林尘独自上路。

    穿过枯骨林的时候毒瘴比来时更浓了，灰白色的雾气贴着地面流动，能见度不到三丈。

    他体内三种毒素清干净之后抗毒性远超同阶，毒瘴对他来说和普通雾气没什么区别，连呼吸节奏都没乱。

    出了枯骨林，又走了两天，远远看到一座暗红色的山。

    火毒宗建在枯骨林尽头的一座活火山脚下，整座山峰通体暗红，山体表面布满了裂痕，裂痕深处渗出暗红色的岩浆光芒。

    山门是由两块天然形成的火山岩拼成，石门表面刻满了密密麻麻的毒纹——不是装饰，是上古毒典的原文，每一道毒纹都代表一种独门毒术，从念毒到腐骨毒到万毒窟里封存的禁术毒方，全刻在这扇门上。

    两个守门弟子穿着暗红色的宗门道袍，袖口绣着一团燃烧的毒火，修为都是筑基后期。

    他们看见林尘走过来，伸手拦住了他。

    “外人不得入内。火毒宗不对外开放，若无内门弟子推荐或宗门信物，请回。”

    林尘从怀里摸出唐玉那枚暗红色的令牌。

    令牌上的“毒”字在火山岩的反光下泛着幽幽冷光。

    守门弟子低头看了一眼令牌，表情从冷淡变成了紧张，其中一人转身快步进了山门，另一人留在原地，目光在林尘脸上来回扫了两遍。

    “这枚令牌是唐玉的。她叛逃多年，令牌早已注销。你拿着已注销的令牌来火毒宗，什么目的。”

    “告诉她哥唐铮，当年的真相。”

    守门弟子正要开口，身后传来一阵极轻的脚步声。

    一个穿着暗红色长袍的女人从山门里走出来，金丹中期修为，袖口绣着一团燃烧的毒火和一枚极细的银针——内门炼丹师的标识。

    她的脸色冷白，是长期接触毒性药材后形成的那种白。

    她走到山门口，目光在林尘领口那枚银质药鼎胸针上停了片刻。

    “这枚胸针是谁给你的。”

    “苏荇。五柳城东街徐氏炼丹摊的学徒，你的师妹。她说你看到这枚胸针会帮我。”

    “她怎么没跟你一起来。”

    “她在落雁谷等紫鳞果成熟。”

    穆青转身往山门里走。

    “跟我来。唐玉的令牌不用再拿出来了，火毒宗里认得这枚令牌的人不止我一个，有些人不太想看到它被拿出来。”
content_en:
It took five days of horseback riding from Luoyan Valley to Huodu Sect.

    Su Yun stayed in the valley and waited for the third purple-scaled fruit to mature, while Lin Chen went on the road alone.

    When passing through the Bone Forest, the poisonous miasma was thicker than when we came. The gray-white mist flowed close to the ground, and the visibility was less than three feet.

    After the three toxins in his body were cleansed, the poison resistance was far higher than that of the same level. To him, the poisonous miasma was no different from ordinary mist, and even his breathing rhythm was not disrupted.

    After leaving the Bone Forest and walking for two more days, I saw a dark red mountain in the distance.

    The Fire Poison Sect was built at the foot of an active volcano at the end of the Dry Bone Forest. The entire mountain peak was dark red. The surface of the mountain was covered with cracks, and dark red magma light oozed from the depths of the cracks.

    The mountain gate is made up of two naturally formed volcanic rocks. The surface of the stone gate is covered with dense poisonous patterns - not decoration, but the original text of the ancient poison code. Each poisonous pattern represents a unique poison technique, from mind poison to rotten bone poison to the forbidden poison prescriptions sealed in the Ten Thousand Poison Cave, all are engraved on this door.

    The two gatekeeper disciples were wearing dark red sect robes with a burning poisonous fire embroidered on their sleeves. They were both in the late stage of Foundation Establishment.

    They saw Lin Chen approaching and stretched out their hands to stop him.

    "Outsiders are not allowed in. The Fire Poison Sect is not open to the public. If you don't have recommendations from inner disciples or sect tokens, please come back."

    Lin Chen took out Tang Yu's dark red token from his arms.

    The word "poison" on the token glowed faintly under the reflection of the volcanic rocks.

    The gatekeeper disciples lowered their heads and glanced at the token, their expressions changing from cold to nervous. One of them turned around and quickly entered the mountain gate, while the other stayed where he was, scanning Lin Chen's face twice.

    "This token belongs to Tang Yu. She has defected for many years, and the token has been canceled long ago. What is your purpose in coming to the Fire Poison Sect with a canceled token?"

    "Tell her brother Tang Zheng the truth about that year."

    Just as the gatekeeper disciple was about to speak, there was a burst of very light footsteps behind him.

    A woman wearing a dark red robe walked out of the mountain gate. She was in the middle stage of Jindan cultivation. Her sleeves were embroidered with a burning poisonous fire and a very fine silver needle - the logo of the inner alchemist.

    Her face was cold and pale, the kind that results from long-term exposure to toxic medicinal materials.

    She walked to the gate of the mountain and her eyes paused for a moment on the silver medicine cauldron brooch on Lin Chen's collar.

    "Who gave you this brooch?"

    "Su Yun. Apprentice from Xu's alchemy stall on Wuliucheng East Street, your junior sister. She said you would help me if you saw this brooch."

    "Why didn't she come with you?"

    "She is waiting for the purple scale fruit to mature in Luoyan Valley."

    Mu Qing turned around and walked into the mountain gate.

    "Follow me. There is no need to take out Tang Yu's token. I am not the only one in the Fire Poison Sect who recognizes this token. Some people don't want to see it taken out."
